name: Trainual
description: Trainual combines process documentation, assigned employee training, knowledge search, and completion reporting. Compare its training controls with a simpler team wiki before choosing a plan.
best_for: Teams that need repeatable employee onboarding and evidence of training completion, rather than only a searchable place to store documents.
features: Knowledge search and reusable training templates
Tests, due dates, and completion reporting
Individual training paths on Pro and above
SSO and custom domain on Premium and Enterprise
API and custom integration support on Enterprise

alternatives.name: Guru
alternatives.description: An enterprise knowledge-management platform that organizes and continuously verifies company information.

alternatives.name: Tettra
alternatives.description: An AI-powered internal knowledge base built around a Slack-first workflow for answering team questions.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a lightweight internal wiki rather than a full training suite

alternatives.name: Confluence
alternatives.description: Atlassian's team workspace for documentation, meeting notes, and internal knowledge.
alternatives.best_for: Teams already standardized on Atlassian tools

pricing.starting_price: Confirm the full annual quote, minimum commitment, and implementation fee

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: Documentation, knowledge search, group assignments, and testing. The page displays a $3/user/month annual-billing rate alongside a 10-seat / $3,000 annual minimum footnote. The relationship between these figures is unclear; do not treat the per-user figure as an all-in entry price.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Adds individual training paths, hosted-video controls and e-signatures. A $4/user/month annual-billing figure is displayed; confirm the base subscription, included seats and minimum commitment in the quote.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Adds SSO, custom domain and higher training limits. A $5/user/month annual-billing figure is displayed; confirm the total subscription rather than multiplying this figure by headcount.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: API and custom integration support; request an itemized quote.

pros: Combines documentation with assigned learning and completion reporting.
The edition matrix distinguishes training controls from basic document storage.
Training reports can be exported for review, rather than relying only on verbal confirmation.
cons: Published per-user figures do not by themselves establish the minimum payable subscription.
The vendor FAQ lists a separate one-time $1,000 implementation fee; confirm its treatment in the final quote.
Individual training paths, SSO and API access have different edition requirements; they are not all entry-plan features.
